what_this_is: Every grid strip in one file. The gallery drew these from 116 separate fetches and the tail of them went missing on a slow connection, so the grid now makes one request and the per-frame files serve the lightbox alone. Downsampled from those files by pipeline/waveform.py --cards.
encoding: min and max are base64 int8, full scale +-127; multiply by scale for master units
